findings.title: Update public-profile reactions only after confirmed success
findings.body: Original finding 12 now has handlers, but likes and bookmarks discard request failures with try? and toggle displayed state unconditionally. Failed requests falsely appear successful; successful returned states are also ignored. Apply the returned Boolean, surface failures without changing local state, and prevent overlapping mutations of the same target.

findings.title: Require a choice for unknown prefilled grades
findings.body: Original finding 22 remains: null route grades become the first grade in the system, such as VB or 5.0, rather than staying unknown. Custom routes still receive V0 with an empty picker, and Save is enabled because that fabricated value is nonempty. Preserve an ungraded selection until the user explicitly chooses a valid grade and provide custom-label input.

findings.title: Preserve the fetched public-profile fields
findings.body: The correction drops avatarUrl, bio, and homeArea when mapping Profile to CommunityClimber. PublicProfileView consumes bio/homeArea, so production profiles now lose facts returned by the server while fixture profiles conceal the regression. Pass those optional fields through.

findings.title: Page through Profile's saved-route collection
findings.body: Original finding 18 is repaired in Explore but not Profile. fetchSavedRoutes still requests only 50 entries, and ProductProfileViewModel/ProfileView treat that as the complete collection without a cursor or continuation control. Users with more than 50 bookmarks cannot browse them all from Profile. Consume the RPC's createdAt/id pagination contract.

findings.title: Make private-history entries reopen their attempts
findings.body: Original finding 26 is partial. New private-session rows show venue, time, conditions, and notes but have no detail control and never load attempts. After dismissing a completed session's result, neither Profile nor Log history can reopen its individual private attempts. Provide an owner-scoped private detail destination without requiring publication.

findings.title: Include locally persisted sessions in offline history
findings.body: The new history claims to show on-device sessions but only queries the remote repository and converts failures to an empty array. An offline completed session remains in PendingSession/PendingAttempt yet is absent from Log history; Profile's all-or-nothing remote load instead shows an error. Merge account-scoped local and remote history and distinguish failure from genuinely empty data.

findings.title: Match server character-count semantics for session context
findings.body: Original finding 23 still admits oversized Unicode context: Swift String.count/prefix count grapheme clusters, whereas PostgreSQL text-length constraints count code points. For example, 501 decomposed accented characters pass the 1000-character Notes check but contain 1002 code points, causing repeated session-upsert failure and blocked attempts/publication. Validate server-equivalent bounds and report errors rather than silently truncating.

shared_contract: Platform iOS mechanics of frozen BOTH-platform V1 semantics. Preserve SessionPostCard onLike/onBookmark/onAuthorTap/onRouteTap ()->Void names and wire real callbacks everywhere; optional nil may replace default no-op if needed to render noninteractive when absent, coordinate exact type with journal owner. NativeFixtures owns SharedFixtureStore: remove process-wide shared; init(savedRouteIDs:Set<UUID>=[], followedClimberIDs:Set<UUID>=[]), synchronized private sets, isSaved(_:UUID)->Bool,isFollowing(_:UUID)->Bool,toggleSavedRoute(_:UUID)->Bool,toggleFollow(_:UUID)->Bool. All mock repository initializers gain fixtureStore:SharedFixtureStore?=nil; nil means new isolated store honoring existing supplied seeds. AppServices owns one explicit shared fixture instance supplied to feed/community/profile mocks. Journal owner implements MockProfileRepository constructor/projections against that same interface; no singleton anywhere. ProfileRepository.fetchSavedRoutes pagination may evolve with every current caller in journal-owned paths. Fixtures owner coordinates its tests against resulting signature, do not edit journal files. Journal private history reuses SessionRepository and SessionSyncService/SwiftData, no second persistence store; preserve account ownership and local pending edits. All workers skip all builds/tests/lint/formatters; Main verifies once immutable.
